title: malvastrum violaceum
intro: Malvastrum violaceum, commonly known as "Purple Mallow", is a plant species belonging to the family Malvaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Malvastrum violaceum include soothing and calming effects, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and wounds.
